author: mikiminach
body:
Builder Application ~ Gxbriell

Part 1:
Q: What is your Age?
A: I am currently 14 years old.

Q: What is your Discord ID?
A: Username: Gabxb
    Discord ID: #9617

Q:  How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?
A: Because I am taking part in a summer program, I may be active for at least 2-3 days a week depending on my schedule.

Q: What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?
A: The difference between me and other applicants may be that I am able to build in a team and listen to someone else's instructions, while at the same time I can build independently and by myself. My building style may be different from the other applicants.

Part 2:
Q: What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?
A: In order for me to refine my building skills in terms of gameplay, I think i just need to practice, and continue to practice overtime. I can learn from my mistakes and improve on it next time, and soon enough, my building skills can be perfected.

Q: How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?
A: I would not be comfortable when it comes to using or creating XML files.

Q: As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?
A: As a builder, I would focus completely on building maps instead of creating XML.

Part 3:
Links to maps:
https://mega.nz/#F!xPZFnKiY!IzlvlOhN3b4YuMz6RxDsjw
https://mega.nz/#F!hShmELIZ!AoCZxc98Fwuv7stVT0UMhw

Q:Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.
A: No, I haven't, however, I build on other servers and in my free time.

Part 4:
Q:Why do you want to be a builder?
A: The two main reasons why I want to become a builder is because:
     1. building is what I love and want to do for other people.
     2. The Avicus community has given me so much, like friends and enjoyment, so being a builder would be my way of giving back to the community.

Q: How do you think you will help the map development team?
A: The way I would be beneficial towards the development team is just helping them build maps for other people to enjoy. As I said previously, I can be cooperative while building with a group, and they just might need the help.

title: Gxbriell's Builder Application

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
Hello,

We looked at the maps you submitted, and they just aren't up to standards. They were a bit too small, and very bland. I recommend that if you choose to make more maps, you post pictures of them in the appropriate subforum for feedback from the community, so that you can improve your skills.

This application is denied; have a nice day.
